overlap_analysis.finding: The deepest treatment of transactions anywhere in the tree. The easy-db lane applied the four properties as definitions and this file argues each of them; the isolation property in particular turns out to have four settable levels defined by which of three anomalies they permit, which nothing applied covered.
overlap_analysis.disposition: Nine applied concepts take evidence - the data source and the pool from the sixth week, the transaction and its four properties from easy-db, the rollback default from the first week of this study, and the self-invocation trap from the fourth. New: how the pool hands out a connection and how large to make it, the boundary and what managing it by hand costs, the per-thread synchronisation and the abstraction over it, the proxy the annotation works through, and the six attributes including propagation and the isolation levels.

candidates.title: DataSource
aliases: 커넥션 정보로 스프링이 만들어 둔 빈
candidates.concept_granularity: single object through which a database connection is obtained, which spring boot builds from the connection settings and registers as a bean, so anything needing it has it injected rather than constructing it

locators.heading: ## 스프링 DB 접근 기술 > ### 순수 JDBC

candidates.title: 커넥션 풀
candidates.concept_granularity: single arrangement for the cost of opening a database connection - a number of them are opened in advance and lent out as needed rather than made and destroyed per request

candidates.title: 트랜잭션
candidates.concept_granularity: single logical unit of work - several SQL statements bound together for a reason outside the database, so that they cannot be divided and it can never happen that only some of them reach the data

candidates.title: 원자성
candidates.concept_granularity: single guarantee that a transaction either happens entirely or not at all - a failure partway through cancels everything already done, as if nothing had happened - where making commit permanent and rollback complete is the DBMS's job and deciding the transaction's boundary and what counts as a failure is the developer's

candidates.title: 일관성
aliases: 일관된 상태에서 또 다른 일관된 상태로
candidates.concept_granularity: single guarantee that a transaction moves the database from one consistent state to another - a transaction violating a rule declared in the database, whether a constraint or a trigger, is rolled back, and the DBMS checks those rules before the commit; whatever consistency means to the application beyond them is the developer's to keep

candidates.title: 격리성
candidates.concept_granularity: single guarantee that concurrent transactions behave as though each ran alone, offered at several levels because enforcing it strictly costs performance - a higher level shields a transaction from the others but lowers concurrency, a lower level raises concurrency at the risk of wrong results - and the level is the developer's to choose

candidates.title: 지속성
candidates.concept_granularity: single guarantee that a committed transaction survives - it stays in the database through a power failure or a crash, which is what storing it permanently on non-volatile media means, and the DBMS is what provides it

candidates.title: 스프링의 기본 롤백 정책
candidates.concept_granularity: single default that surprises people - the transaction annotation rolls back for unchecked exceptions and errors but not for checked ones, so an exception that the compiler forced the code to declare will let the transaction commit unless the policy is configured otherwise or the exception is rethrown

candidates.title: 자기 자신을 호출하면 AOP가 걸리지 않는다
candidates.concept_granularity: single consequence of the proxy approach that catches everyone - the advice lives on the proxy, so a call arriving from outside passes through it while a call the target makes to its own method does not, which is why an annotation on an inner or private method has no effect; the transaction annotation is an aspect like any other and fails the same way

candidates.title: 커넥션 풀이 커넥션을 내주는 순서
candidates.concept_granularity: single order the default pool follows when asked for a connection - it looks first among those this thread used before, then among all the free ones, and only if none is available does it wait on a hand-off queue until one is returned or the timeout expires and it throws

candidates.title: 커넥션 풀 크기를 정할 때
candidates.concept_granularity: single trade in sizing the pool - a larger one costs memory and shortens waiting, a smaller one the reverse - constrained by the threads that use it, since connections beyond the thread count are only occupying memory, and bounded above by the database's disk, past which more threads only add switching cost and contend for the same input and output

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 경계 설정
aliases: 직접 관리할 때의 네 가지 부담
candidates.concept_granularity: single decision of where a transaction begins and ends, which has to be one business operation rather than one query - otherwise a failure halfway leaves the earlier queries committed - and which, done by hand, complicates the service, requires the connection to be carried through every call, ties the code to one data access technology, and mixes a concern that is not the business logic into it

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 동기화
candidates.concept_granularity: single way of not passing the connection through every method - it is kept in a per-thread store the framework provides, opened and set non-committing when the transaction begins, fetched from there by the repository, and committed or rolled back and returned to the pool at the end; being per-thread it is safe under concurrency, and being about the connection specifically it still binds the code to one technology

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 추상화
candidates.concept_granularity: single interface over every data access technology, justified by their all doing the same three things - begin, commit, roll back - so the application names the abstraction and stays independent of which is underneath, at the usual cost of a layer between the code and what actually happens

candidates.title: 선언적 트랜잭션과 프로그래밍 방식
candidates.concept_granularity: single choice between writing the boundary out and declaring it - writing it out gives exact control over where it starts and ends and is right where there are few, while declaring it separates the transaction from the business logic entirely and is what scales to many, at the cost of inheriting the proxy's limitation on internal calls

candidates.title: @Transactional이 동작하는 방식
candidates.concept_granularity: single mechanism behind the annotation - a proxy is generated around the bean, which receives the call, opens the transaction, invokes the real method and commits or rolls back; because the proxy works by overriding, only methods it can override are advised, which excludes the private ones and equally the static and final ones

candidates.title: 트랜잭션의 여섯 속성
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of six settings the annotation accepts - how it behaves when one is already running, how far it is isolated from others, whether it may write, how long it may take, and which exceptions do and do not roll it back

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 전파
aliases: 이미 진행 중인 트랜잭션이 있을 때
candidates.concept_granularity: single setting deciding what happens when a boundary is reached while another transaction is already open - join it, which is the default and is what merges several boundaries into one; demand one and fail without it; suspend it and start an independent one; tolerate its absence; refuse it; or nest inside it, which differs from the independent form in that the child is rolled back with the parent while the parent is not rolled back with the child - which is what a log written alongside a main operation wants

candidates.title: 격리 수준의 네 단계
candidates.concept_granularity: single ladder from least to most isolated - reading what is not yet committed, which is fastest and admits every anomaly; reading only committed data, which still lets a row change between two reads; preventing that by taking a snapshot at the start, which still lets new rows appear within a range; and running transactions one after another, which admits nothing and costs the most - with the default coming from the driver and differing by product

candidates.title: 격리 수준이 낮을 때 나타나는 현상
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of three anomalies the isolation levels are defined by preventing - reading a value another transaction has not committed and may roll back, reading the same row twice within one transaction and getting different values, and running the same query twice and finding rows that were not there before

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 타임아웃
candidates.concept_granularity: single limit on how long a transaction may run, absent unless set, and meaningful only where the boundary actually starts a new transaction rather than joining one

candidates.title: 읽기 전용 트랜잭션 설정
candidates.concept_granularity: single flag with two purposes - it forbids writing within the transaction, and it lets the layers below optimise, the persistence context skipping its flush and a replicated database routing the work to a read replica
